svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: A reservoir in a storm
svg.desc: The model reservoir; a run lasts 5 days: 2 things and 2 arrows (1 reads, 1 changes). Each thing is a box with its stocks, its flows and its state machines. The arrows show what each thing reads, follows, changes, fires and moves of the others.

g.title: Reservoir Written in model.scn Things that read its values: Operator Things that change its values: Operator (sets)
Water in the reservoir (reservoir.water): a stock Flows to stocks that are not drawn: reservoir.spill
The symbol of Water in the reservoir: W
Water let out over the spillway (reservoir.spilled): a tally Its flows: reservoir.spill

Storm: from outside the model to Water in the reservoir
1: operator.decide, from any state to OPEN, by Operator

Operator Written in model.scn Reads values of: Reservoir Changes values of: Reservoir (sets) Events: • decide — when water is at least level, once; after 0 h: sets order, by order, open: sets gate The water reaches the level at which the operator opens the spillway. Rule: reservoir.water >= this.level
